fb5b7d0c9e7d404e653b723c08858a5ef1766150.summary: AT&T Alien Labs sandboxed several OS X malware families (Flashback, KitM, LaoShu, Mask/Careto, CoinThief, WireLurker, OceanLotus) and recorded persistence methods, C2 details and IDS detections. Most C&C servers were already offline. The report calls 2015 a very prolific year for OS X malware and expects more OS X malware as Apple's corporate share grows.
